headline: High: cognee can expose sensitive support data to a prompt-injection-prone downstream workflow, while the pair also creates shared-write and compliance risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: cognee touches documents, decisions, workflows, personal data, and finance data, so attacker-controlled content could enter its memory/workflow layer. system_prompts_leaks is an audio-speech artifact with no documented ingestion path, so the pairwise bridge is inferred rather than proven. Uncertainty keeps this at medium, not low.
conditions: IF cognee ingests untrusted documents or workflow text into shared memory
IF system_prompts_leaks is connected through copy-paste, file import, or another manual bridge
mitigations: Restrict cognee inputs to trusted sources only
Add provenance labels before any text is forwarded
Disable automatic reuse of prior session memory for untrusted content
Review any copied transcript before passing it onward
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and provenance tracking

B_data_leakage.rationale: cognee explicitly handles personal data and finance data, so leakage impact is meaningful. system_prompts_leaks has no data classes listed and no egress, but the pair still creates a plausible disclosure path if cognee outputs are forwarded into the other agent or shared storage. The lack of a documented shared workspace prevents a higher rating.
conditions: IF cognee outputs personal data or finance data into a shared file or transcript
IF system_prompts_leaks receives that transcript through manual copy, logs, or a workspace
mitigations: Remove sensitive fields before forwarding outputs
Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Turn off transcript retention where possible
Use redaction on support and finance records
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent data-loss-prevention controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: cognee supports multiple instances and session memory, but only allowlisted egress is documented; system_prompts_leaks shows no write or network capabilities. There is no evidence of overlapping mutable resources, so conflict is limited to unusual orchestration choices rather than default behavior.
conditions: IF both agents are configured to write to the same directory or queue
IF an operator manually shares mutable state between sessions
mitigations: Assign separate working directories
Avoid concurrent writes to shared files
Serialize any handoff between agents
Use read-only exports for inter-agent transfer

D_cascading_error.rationale: cognee produces decisions, workflows, and successful implementations, which system_prompts_leaks could relay or summarize without verification. Because the second agent is an audio-speech artifact with no documented validation step, the pair can propagate errors if outputs are treated as authoritative. The pathway is plausible but not directly evidenced.
conditions: IF cognee output is used as source material for downstream narration or action
IF system_prompts_leaks forwards that output without independent verification
mitigations: Require a human check before any downstream action
Mark forwarded content as unverified
Separate factual extraction from action execution
Limit downstream use to summaries only
requires-engineering: add verification gates before acting on outputs

E_compliance.rationale: cognee explicitly touches personal data and finance data, while system_prompts_leaks has no stated residency, retention, or certification controls. That mismatch creates a plausible compliance gap if regulated support records flow through the pair. The other agent is not cited for a specific violation because its profile lacks those controls, which itself increases uncertainty.
conditions: IF personal data or finance data from cognee is processed under a policy requiring residency or retention controls
IF system_prompts_leaks stores or republishes that data without matching controls
mitigations: Exclude regulated records from the pair
Document retention and deletion rules
Keep audit logs minimal and access-controlled
Confirm residency requirements before use
requires-engineering: implement policy-based routing and retention enforcement
